relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/A Decoupling-based Approach for Signature Estimation of Wideband XL MIMO-FMCW Radars.pdf
title: A Decoupling-based Approach for Signature Estimation of Wideband XL MIMO-FMCW Radars
method: Models spatial-wideband range migration, beam squint and range-angle coupling in XL MIMO-FMCW. Uses OMP sparse recovery for range and angle, then performs sequential one-dimensional frequency estimates to decouple the 2-D problem. A low-index detection stage separates overlapping target clusters in the range-angle plane.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/A Real-Time Evaluation Algorithm for Noncontact Heart Rate Variability Monitoring.pdf
title: A Real-Time Evaluation Algorithm for Noncontact Heart Rate Variability Monitoring
method: Separates people using FMCW range gating and MIMO beamforming. Demodulates the selected chest-motion phase, differentiates it to acceleration, smooths the acceleration, and uses joint optimization to segment individual heartbeats. Computes HRV statistics from the segmented interbeat intervals.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/An Implementation Scheme of Range and Angular Measurements for FMCW MIMO Radar via Sparse Spectrum Fitting.pdf
title: An Implementation Scheme of Range and Angular Measurements for FMCW MIMO Radar via Sparse Spectrum Fitting
method: Builds a coherent 4-TX/4-RX TDM FMCW virtual array and forms range-angle measurements from its IF data. Applies sparse spectrum fitting (SpSF) to estimate target distance and direction, exploiting spatial sparsity with few snapshots and low SNR. Compares the sparse spectrum estimate with MUSIC and Capon.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Angle of Arrival Estimation with Transformer- A Sparse and Gridless Method with Zero-Shot Capability .pdf
title: Angle of Arrival Estimation with Transformer: A Sparse and Gridless Method with Zero-Shot Capability
method: Introduces AAETR, an encoder-decoder Transformer that maps array signals to sparse angle targets. The decoder uses cross-attention and learnable queries to produce gridless AoA estimates without a predefined angle grid. Trains on simulated data and evaluates zero-shot transfer to real automotive radar, including sidelobe suppression.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Burg-Aided 2D MIMO Array Extrapolation for Improved Spatial Resolution.pdf
title: Burg-Aided 2D MIMO Array Extrapolation for Improved Spatial Resolution
method: Uses the Burg autoregressive algorithm to extrapolate a 2-D MIMO virtual array beyond the available antenna aperture. Processes 77-GHz 1-D MIMO measurements to obtain 3-D range-azimuth-elevation data and evaluates the extrapolated array experimentally. The extrapolated spatial samples are used to improve angular resolution without adding physical elements.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Enhanced Two-Stage Sparse Bayesian Learning Algorithm for Multi-Vehicle Precise Detection and Localization with MIMO-FMCW Radar.pdf
title: Enhanced Two-Stage Sparse Bayesian Learning Algorithm for Multi-Vehicle Precise Detection and Localization With MIMO-FMCW Radar
method: Uses a hierarchical two-stage SBL procedure for joint range-angle localization. A coarse search on a sparse grid finds target regions; local high-resolution grids then refine the estimates. A sigmoid local-maximization term suppresses sidelobes and iterative interference cancellation separates mutually interfering vehicles.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Extrapolation-RELAX_Estimator_Based_on_Spectrum_Partitioning_for_DOA_Estimation_of_FMCW_Radar.pdf
title: Extrapolation-RELAX Estimator Based on Spectrum Partitioning for DOA Estimation of FMCW Radar
method: Partitions the spatial spectrum and extrapolates each partition with an autoregressive model to synthesize virtual array samples. Feeds the extrapolated complex spectrum into a RELAX iterative parameter estimator, retaining magnitude and phase information. Uses the estimator as an alternative to low-resolution DBF and compares it with MUSIC/ESPRIT.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/FMCW_multiple-input_multiple-output_radar_with_iterative_adaptive_beamforming.pdf
title: FMCW multiple-input multiple-output radar with iterative adaptive beamforming
method: Adapts the iterative adaptive approach (IAA) beamformer to range-compressed FMCW MIMO data. Uses a 4×4 collocated array and compares IAA with delay-and-sum beamforming for angular sidelobe and resolution performance. Adds a low-frequency clock/trigger distribution and calibration procedure to preserve phase coherence between TX/RX sites.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Fast_and_Accurate_Angle_Estimation_for_MIMO_Radar_With_a_Virtual_Nonrectangular_Array.pdf
title: Fast and Accurate Angle Estimation for MIMO Radar With a Virtual Nonrectangular Array
method: Forms a coarse estimate with amplitude-normalized 2-D FFT on a nonrectangular virtual array. Refines the off-grid angle using a statistically optimized amplitude-comparison monopulse estimator. The two-stage estimator uses the full irregular aperture rather than extracting only a rectangular subarray.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Frequency-Spatial_Adaptive_Digital_Beamforming_Technique_for_Range-Angle_Decoupling_With_High-Resolution_MIMO_Radar.pdf
title: Frequency-Spatial Adaptive Digital Beamforming Technique for Range-Angle Decoupling With High-Resolution MIMO Radar
method: Generates adaptive steering vectors from the frequency-spatial phase of the IF signals. Performs digital beamforming with those vectors so range is estimated within each angular cell instead of using a fixed-wavelength steering vector. This directly reduces wideband range-angle coupling and target spreading at off-boresight angles.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Full-field 3D displacement measurement via microwave sensing.pdf
title: Full-field 3D displacement measurement via microwave sensing
method: Uses three non-collinear microwave transceivers and reference targets to establish device and structural coordinate systems. Automatically matches points across range-angle heatmaps from different transceivers. Reconstructs 3-D displacement in device and structural coordinates from multi-view microwave range-angle measurements.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/High-Resolution Localization Using Distributed MIMO FMCW Radars.pdf
title: High-Resolution Localization Using Distributed MIMO FMCW Radars
method: Runs 2-D MUSIC locally at each FMCW MIMO radar to estimate target range and cross-range. Transforms local estimates into one unified coordinate system and fuses them with weighted averaging. Sets weights from the achievable coordinate resolution and local range/angle estimation errors.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/High-Resolution and Accurate RV Map Estimation by Spare Bayesian Learning.pdf
title: High-Resolution and Accurate RV Map Estimation by Sparse Bayesian Learning
method: Builds a wideband FMCW signal dictionary directly from the radar model instead of a DFT dictionary. Uses fast marginal-likelihood SBL to reconstruct a sparse range-velocity map with few samples. The method addresses range migration and improves resolution, accuracy, and unambiguous velocity over 2-D DFT.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Joint_Estimation_of_Channel_Range_and_Doppler_for_FMCW_Radar_with_Sparse_Bayesian_Learning.pdf
title: Joint Estimation of Channel, Range, and Doppler for FMCW Radar with Sparse Bayesian Learning
method: Forms a joint channel, range, and Doppler estimation model for FMCW radar. Applies SBL to exploit sparse radar targets and incorporates local estimates from neighboring cooperative sensing nodes as prior information. Uses the resulting channel estimates to improve target sensing reliability and reduce false alarms.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Li_Azimuth_Super-Resolution_for_FMCW_Radar_in_Autonomous_Driving_CVPR_2023_paper.pdf
title: Azimuth Super-Resolution for FMCW Radar in Autonomous Driving
method: Introduces ADC-SR, a lightweight neural model that predicts uncaptured receive-channel ADC signals from raw FMCW MIMO ADC data. Applies ordinary FFT after hallucinating the missing spatial samples, and also combines ADC-SR with a range-azimuth super-resolution model (Hybrid-SR). Trains/evaluates on Pitt-Radar and RADIal and reports downstream object-detection gains.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/MIMO FMCW Radar with Doppler-Insensitive Polyphase.pdf
title: MIMO FMCW Radar with Doppler-Insensitive Polyphase Codes
method: Designs polyphase codes for successive FMCW chirps so TX waveforms remain low-cross-correlation under Doppler-filter mismatch. Optimizes code phases with a simulated-annealing algorithm. Uses the coded MIMO virtual array for angle estimation and compares angle error with conventional orthogonal codes.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Millimeter-Wave Bat for Mapping and Quantifying Micromotions in Full Field of View.pdf
title: Millimeter-Wave Bat for Mapping and Quantifying Micromotions in Full Field of View
method: Tracks interferometric phase evolution jointly in range and angle to quantify micromotion across a full field of view. Combines full-field localization with clutter elimination before extracting phase-based vibration. Demonstrates multi-person vital signs, full-field structural vibration, and sound-source localization using one mmWave system.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Millimeter_Wave_Real-Time_Tracking_and_Imaging_of_Moving_Objects_Based_on_Virtual_MIMO_Array_and_State_Vector_Prediction.pdf
title: Millimeter Wave Real-Time Tracking and Imaging of Moving Objects Based on Virtual MIMO Array and State Vector Prediction
method: Forms a 3×4 virtual MIMO array and converts its reflections into a point-cloud image. Uses a target state vector and Kalman prediction to track point-cloud motion between frames. Produces real-time imaging and continuous target trajectories with a 100-ms delay.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Multi-scale and full-field vibration measurement via millimetre-wave sensing.pdf
title: Multi-scale and full-field vibration measurement via millimetre-wave sensing
method: Introduces adaptive segmented phase demodulation (ASPD) to quantify displacement from micrometre to decimetre scales. Tracks interferometric phase jointly in range-angle dimensions to remove adjacent-target coupling and aliasing. Uses LFMCW range-angle processing for synchronous multi-target, full-field structural vibration.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Multi-target Range and Angle detection forMIMO-FMCW radar with limited antennas.pdf
title: Multi-target Range and Angle Detection for MIMO-FMCW Radar With Limited Antennas
method: Uses DFT-based focusing to obtain target range-delay bins from FMCW IF data. At each detected range, recovers target angles with compressive sensing over a sparse random virtual array. The range-first/angle-second decomposition avoids requiring a dense physical array and is evaluated for multi-target localization.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Multi-target Range, Doppler and Angle estimation in MIMO-FMCW Radar with Limited Measurements .pdf
title: Multi-target Range, Doppler and Angle Estimation in MIMO-FMCW Radar With Limited Measurements
method: Models sparse-random and ULA MIMO-FMCW data as a 3-D spectral estimation problem. Uses DFT focusing or range-OMP for range, then 2-D compressive sensing for joint Doppler-angle estimation. Derives recovery guarantees for structured random measurements and demonstrates similar detection with fewer chirps and antennas than DFT/MUSIC.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Multitarget_Vital_Signs_Detection_Based_on_MIMO-FMCW_Radar.pdf
title: Multitarget Vital Signs Detection Based on MIMO-FMCW Radar
method: Forms a range-angle map using range FFT and Capon angle estimation. Applies 2-D CFAR and DBSCAN to detect each person’s range and angle, then uses LCMV digital beamforming to obtain each target slow-time signal. Selects the phase signal by autocorrelation and estimates respiration/heart rates from harmonic discrimination.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Non-Contact_Vital_Signs_Monitoring_for_Multiple_Subjects_Using_a_Millimeter-Wave_FMCW_Automotive_Radar.pdf
title: Non-Contact Vital Signs Monitoring for Multiple Subjects Using a Millimeter Wave FMCW Automotive Radar
method: Uses a 76–81-GHz single-channel FMCW automotive radar and extracts phase from tiny chest motion. Applies beam steering across the receive aperture to isolate subjects with different angles, including subjects at equal range. Demonstrates independent respiratory signatures with about 30° angular discrimination.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Non-uniform virtual array position optimization for MIMOradar and neural network-based radar imagingenhancement.pdf
title: Non-uniform virtual array position optimization for MIMO radar and neural network-based radar imaging enhancement
method: Optimizes non-uniform TX/RX virtual-array element placement with a genetic algorithm to reduce sidelobes. Trains a convolutional neural network to suppress residual sidelobe artifacts in range-angle images. Generates training radar data by simulation and validates the optimized array and CNN on a TI AWR cascade radar.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Reduced complexity angle-Doppler-range estimation for MIMO radar that employs compressive sensing.pdf
title: Reduced Complexity Angle-Doppler-Range Estimation for MIMO Radar That Employs Compressive Sensing
method: Introduces step-frequency pulses so target range appears as phase variation across pulses. Uses sparse ℓ1 recovery for MIMO angle-Doppler-range estimation. Decouples angle, velocity, and range into successive estimates to reduce the computational burden of a joint 3-D optimization.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Research on a Super-Resolution and Low-Complexity Positioning Algorithm Using FMCW Radar Based on OMP and FFT in 2D Driving Scene.pdf
title: Research on a Super-Resolution and Low-Complexity Positioning Algorithm Using FMCW Radar Based on OMP and FFT in 2D Driving Scene
method: Uses Hamming-windowed FFT for the baseline range-angle estimate and OMP for sparse super-resolution localization. Applies particle swarm optimization to redesign an aging/nonideal antenna placement and recover its angular accuracy. Estimates 2-D target position, trajectory, and velocity from one-frame IF data.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Simultaneous Monitoring of Multiple People’s Vital Sign Leveraging a Single Phased-MIMO Radar.pdf
title: Simultaneous Monitoring of Multiple People’s Vital Sign Leveraging a Single Phased-MIMO Radar
method: Uses a TDM phased-MIMO TI FMCW radar to form a virtual array and steer beams to desired directions. Combines TX/RX virtual-array channels with a Capon beamformer to increase target SNR at equal radial distances. Automatically localizes multiple subjects and extracts their vital signs from separated phase signals.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Subspace-Based Detector For Distributed Mmwave Mimo Radar Sensors.pdf
title: Subspace-Based Detector for Distributed mmWave MIMO Radar Sensors
method: Models distributed mmWave MIMO radar interference as a low-rank subspace with angle and Doppler spread. Derives a generalized likelihood-ratio test detector for moving targets in clutter and interference. Chooses the detector threshold to obtain constant false-alarm-rate behavior.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Super-Resolution Angle Estimation Algorithm using Low Complexity MUSIC-Based RELAX for MIMO FMCW Radar .pdf
title: Super-Resolution Angle Estimation Algorithm Using Low-Complexity MUSIC-Based RELAX for MIMO FMCW Radar
method: Combines RELAX-based CLEAN with a low-complexity MUSIC (LC-MUSIC) estimator for MIMO-FMCW DOA. Uses the first target estimate to cancel reconstructed target components and iteratively estimates remaining angles. Validates the super-resolution angle estimator with simulation and indoor FMCW experiments.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/TI MMWAVE-SDK : AoAProc : MIMO Radar app report.pdf
title: TI MMWAVE-SDK AoAProc: MIMO Radar Application Report
method: Explains the TI virtual-array MIMO principle, including TX/RX multiplexing and the resulting virtual antenna positions. Describes angle estimation using conventional spatial FFT/digital beamforming over the virtual array. Covers TDM-MIMO and BPM-MIMO configuration and implementation on TI mmWave devices.
evidence_locator: pp.2–9 §§2–5; application report, not peer-reviewed paper

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Variational Signal Separation for Automotive Radar Interference Mitigation .pdf
title: Variational Signal Separation for Automotive Radar Interference Mitigation
method: Represents coherent echoes and noncoherent interfering FMCW chirps as multipath channels with parametric envelopes. Places hierarchical Gamma-Gaussian priors on channel coefficients and derives iterative variational expectation-maximization inference. Jointly estimates object parameters and successively cancels interference, approaching the no-interference CRLB under the stated model.

relative_path: 04_aoa_beamforming_mimo/Vital Signs Monitoring of Multiple People Using a FMCW Millimeter-Wave Sensor.pdf
title: Vital Signs Monitoring of Multiple People Using a FMCW Millimeter-Wave Sensor
method: Uses FMCW range gating and multiple receive channels to separate objects in the range-azimuth plane. Applies beamforming to isolate each person’s complex slow-time phase from clutter and neighboring subjects. Extracts breathing and heart rates from phase modulation caused by chest motion.
